sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, so they will be strong favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have lost their last five games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close on the leaders if Sandbach slip up. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth face a test against Eccleshall at home; Bridgnorth are in strong form with six wins in their last seven, though Eccleshall have also been competitive. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash, with both sides looking to improve their records. Bilston Town, in fine form with five wins in their last six, host Foley Meir in a local derby-style encounter. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between sides struggling to find consistency. Barnton, unbeaten in their last three, host Shawbury United, who are in a difficult run of form with five losses in their last six. Crewe, also struggling near the bottom, face fellow low-ranked side Allscott Heath at home. Cheadle Heath Nomads, among the division's poorest performers, travel to Telford Town, another side struggling at the wrong end of the table. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, with the visitors rock-bottom and winless from their seven games so far.
